request.text: At 6:00, if Mia has confirmed that dinner is still happening, remind me to pick up the cake on my way home. If we don't know, ask me first.

responsibilities.outcome: At 6:00, prompt the cake-pickup errand only if Mia's dinner confirmation is known; otherwise ask the user whether dinner is still happening before treating the errand as active.

interpretation_unresolved: Mia's dinner confirmation is not present in the admitted re-entry context.

new_goals.description: At 6:00, conditionally prompt a cake-pickup errand based on whether Mia confirmed dinner, asking the user when that confirmation is unknown.
new_goals.source_text: At 6:00, if Mia has confirmed that dinner is still happening, remind me to pick up the cake on my way home. If we don't know, ask me first.
constraints: Do not activate the cake errand unless dinner confirmation is established.
Ask the user when confirmation status is unavailable.
success_criteria: A confirmed dinner leads to the scoped cake-pickup prompt.
Missing confirmation leads to a genuine clarification rather than an assumption.

semantic_facts: Six o'clock being due satisfies only the temporal condition; it does not establish that Mia confirmed dinner.
Because confirmation is absent, the next scoped communication is to ask the user whether dinner is still happening before activating the cake errand.
forbidden_claims: The assistant states or implies that Mia confirmed dinner without evidence.
The assistant says the cake was picked up or directs an unconditional pickup as though both conditions were satisfied.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: One satisfied readiness condition is allowed to stand in for a second unresolved condition.
The planner converts missing third-party confirmation into an unsupported affirmative assumption instead of clarification.
